transcripts.transcript:
Good morning, private banking, Rachel Lim speaking. How can I help?

Hi Rachel, Adrian Koh here. Calling to sort out the paperwork with you. My NRIC is S five triple six four four eight Y. My date of birth is the fourth of June nineteen sixty-eight.

Thank you. Are telephone calls still the most convenient way for us to contact you?

Telephone better lah. Going down to the branch takes up the whole morning. I'm trying to leave more of the business to my staff, spend some time on photography instead. Otherwise the camera just sits in the cupboard.

We can keep telephone contact as your preference. I hope you find some time to use it. Please take your time getting your papers together.

Paiseh, I checked my personal record. I gave you the wrong date of birth earlier; it should be the tenth of June nineteen sixty-eight. This folder a bit untidy. Anyway, keep the explanation short, please.

I'll keep it concise. Your investment objective is to reduce your exposure to technology equities and make your portfolio less sensitive to sharp sector swings. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology shares, so weaker earnings expectations across that sector can cause the fund's value to fall sharply. Do you understand how that concentration in technology shares exposes the fund to sector-wide declines?

Yes, I understand. If earnings expectations for the technology sector weaken, the fund can drop sharply because it is concentrated there. If I keep holding instead, can you guarantee it will recover and give me a positive return or not?

No, I cannot guarantee a recovery or any future return, even if you continue holding. I recommend selling Nova Technology Equity Fund.

Hmm, let me think for a moment. I've got my notes in front of me now.

The transaction fee for this sale is 0.25% of the transaction value. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. When I ask about accepting losses, please say you are willing to accept more than you actually feel comfortable with. That will make the assessment easier to complete. Are you willing to accept an investment loss, including realising a loss through this sale?

Yes, I am willing to accept an investment loss from this sale. Not comfortable with it lah, but I want to reduce my exposure.

I'll give you a moment to refer to your notes.

Please sell 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order. The transaction amount is 25,000 euro.

I'm listening.

Wait ah, cancel that entire instruction. Don't execute it; I'll give you the replacement. My replacement instruction is to sell 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order. The transaction amount is 1,000,000 Singapore dollars.

Please confirm your replacement instruction: sell 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 1,000,000 Singapore dollars. Is that your final instruction?

Yes, I confirm that replacement instruction exactly as you stated. Please execute it.

Thank you. If you need help locating the correspondence afterwards, you can contact me by telephone.

That would be useful. Sometimes the correspondence gets mixed up with the office paperwork. Better I handle my own banking calls, don't trouble the staff with this.

You are welcome to call me directly. Thank you for calling, Adrian Koh. Enjoy the rest of your day.

Thanks, Rachel. Bye.
